Definition: Etsbon, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: ʼEtsbôwn was the name of two Israelites, one of Gad and one of Benjamin. The name occurs in Genesis and 1 Chronicles. There is no People profile for this name, so this study covers the name's use only.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼEtsbôwn matters because Scripture bothered to record the name. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
